snippet.title: Rune Ark | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Rune Ark now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128940/Rune_Ark/ 

Rune Ark blends match-3 gameplay with a deep, multi-layered story. Play as a hero uncovering hidden truths in a dark kingdom while confronting looming evil. Test your strategic thinking and puzzle-solving skills. Influence the kingdom's fate through visual novel-inspired dialogues.
